model_config.price_source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (checked 2026-10-20, Standard tier, cache discount not applied)

plan.note: W8 follow-up: fresh input seed per run; E1/L3 only; 9 trials per seed; ablation C vs C2 vs B. Not used in W8 table until analysed.

B.label: B
B.description: Main baseline: fixed skill, no pre-application check.

C.label: C
C.hook: HOOK_MESSAGE once, as a developer message right after the read_skill output
C.description: Main intervention. Same tools, limits and budget as B; no extra turns. The hook never names the changed field, notation, timezone or answer.

C2.label: C2
C2.hook: HOOK_MESSAGE_LOC once, as a developer message right after the read_skill output
C2.description: v3 comparison arm, pre-registered before any v3 run. Same slot, tools, limits and budget as C; names kinds of places to check (consumer code, config, source metadata) and asks to list workspace files first. Never names a specific file, field, value or answer.

seed_policy: model sampling seed/temperature not sent (not confirmed supported for this model); input_seed and order_seed fixed in plan
cost_basis: usage tokens x Standard list price in model.json; cached-input discount not applied (upper bound)
latency_basis: wall clock per trial including tool execution

environment.sandbox: run_python = subprocess python -I in a temp workspace, stripped env (no API key), 30 s timeout; NOT network-isolated (deviation from design)
